content: Supabase RLS performance (official benchmarks): index every column used in policies (171ms -> <0.1ms); wrap auth.uid()/auth.jwt() in (select ...) so it is evaluated once as initPlan (179ms -> 9ms; 11s -> 7ms with joins); use security definer helper functions for membership checks (178s -> 12ms); add explicit tenant_id filters in app queries even with RLS (171ms -> 9ms); specify TO authenticated. Verified against supabase troubleshooting doc rls-performance-and-best-practices.
